<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Provide chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Start production and updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AssembleFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Updates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AssembleFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleFirst_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates during production">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Updates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="First chainsaw produced and updates sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleFirst_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer's feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikes" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Liked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemaining" name="Produce the remaining chainsaws">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Remaining_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderProduced" name="Remaining order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Remaining_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotLiked" name="First chainsaw not liked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AssembleFirst" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleFirst_Join" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_SendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="EndEvent_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Remaining_End" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderProduced"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Provide chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Update" name="Send production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide feedback on first chainsaw" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Start production and updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ProduceFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ProduceFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleFirst_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleFirst_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback on the first chainsaw" messageRef="Message_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutcomeMerge_ProductionJoin</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleFirst_SendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Remaining_OutcomeMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeMerge_ProductionJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdates_ProductionJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductionJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProductionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce the first chainsaw and send updates concurrently">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AssembleFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble parts into the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AssembleFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleFirst_ProductionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates during production" messageRef="Message_Update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendUpdates_ProductionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Production of the first chainsaw is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="First chainsaw assembled and production updates completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleFirst_ProductionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendUpdates_ProductionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProductionJoin_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProductionJoin_SendFirstSaw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback on the first chainsaw" messageRef="Message_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikes" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Liked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemaining" name="Produce the rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Remaining_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderProduced" name="Rest of the order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Remaining_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotLiked" name="Customer does not like the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AssembleFirst" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleFirst_ProductionJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdates_ProductionJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductionJoin_SendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_ReceiveFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="EndEvent_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Remaining_End" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderProduced"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an activity follows the process start or another activity: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows in the stated order, preserving any intervening gateways and branches
rules.situation: the description states that an activity follows another activity, or that work depends on a stated decision or prerequisite

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or milestone for which a BPMN task is being labeled: Label the task to preserve the action and purpose stated in the description; do not substitute a related but different action or milestone.
rules.situation: the description names an activity, decision, or outcome and a BPMN element is labeled for it

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that activities can happen in parallel or that one activity occurs during another activity: Model those activities as concurrent branches and preserve their stated dependencies and order; do not impose a sequential order that the description does not require.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that activities can happen in parallel or that one activity occurs during another activity

rules.instruction: When the description states the action, purpose, recipient, scope, or outcome of a process element: Label the corresponding BPMN element with a concise phrase that preserves those stated semantics; do not substitute a related but different meaning, omit distinguishing details, or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description states a BPMN element’s action, object, recipient, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description states that an initial deliverable is sent for customer review, that later work depends on the customer's approval, and that status communications occur during the initial work: Model the status communications alongside the initial work, and represent the customer's review as a decision that gates the later work; connect the approval outcome to that work.
rules.situation: the description states that an initial deliverable is sent for customer review, that later work depends on the customer's approval, and that status communications occur during the initial work
